notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check; the evidence is contract_checked and never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored (authored_by kind model) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware run and no claim that the wire syntax was tried on an instrument. The fake is a stateful in-memory SCPI transport; every number in it is placeholder test data. The clone states no frequency, AC voltage, AC current, DC bias or impedance-range bound, so those limits are Limit.operator_required; site-limits.example.json only illustrates an operator's narrowing values. NOT COVERED: the status text of fetch_formatted_with_status is not mapped (the numeric status code is returned); list sweep, bin sorting, correction execution and the open/short/load correction states are not served. The MCP projection bounds the single configure tool to 2048 bytes, so DC bias autorange, correction method, data format, long ASCII formatting, exponent digits, trigger source, trigger delay, continuous initiation and impedance autorange are read-only in this package. The upstream get_all_system_errors loop is represented by the bridge's automatic error query after writes and by one x-cap error-queue read, not by a loop action.
